newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices steady despite natural gas rise.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices steady despite natural gas rise.

text.p: Bulk wholesale electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were steady Wednesday despite a rise in the price of physical natural gas prices in the state, industry sources said.
Natural gas prices in Texas were again said to have risen Wednesday, although the rise had little impact on power prices.
Peak, firm electricity in ERCOT for Thursday delivery was said to be talked steady at $23.00-24.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak ERCOT power for Thursday delivery was said to be higher however, in the $14.00-17.00 range from $12.00-14.00 on Tuesday, the sources said.
November peak ERCOT power was talked steady at $22.00-22.50, while December was reported unchanged at $23.00-24.00, the industry sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
